install_tell: Tier-A* (no auth primitive ships at all -> effectively Tier-A). hayhooks create_app() adds only RequestId + CORS middleware; AppSettings has NO auth field (no HAYHOOKS_API_KEY, no bearer/APIKeyHeader dependency). Legacy rest_api: FastAPI(title='Haystack REST API', debug=True) with CORS allow_origins=['*'], allow_credentials=True. Both rely entirely on external reverse proxy/ACL the docs do not prescribe. Operators set HAYHOOKS_HOST=0.0.0.0 for containers -> the exposure misconfig.
